summary: Short text description shown on mouse hover or keyboard focus.
whenToUse: Clarifying what a control does, especially icon buttons.
whenNotToUse: Essential information or interactive content: use Popover or visible text.
As the only channel on touch devices: the tooltip does not appear on tap.

props.name: children
props.description: Focusable trigger from the library (Button, IconButton, Link…) or wrapped in react-aria's Focusable.

props.name: placement
props.description: Preferred placement; flips when there is not enough space.

props.name: delay
props.description: Opening delay on mouse hover (ms). Keyboard focus opens it immediately.

props.name: showArrow
props.description: Shows the arrow pointing to the trigger.

keyboard.action: Focusing the trigger shows the tooltip.
Hides the tooltip without moving focus.

accessibility: Linked to the trigger with aria-describedby: it supplements, not replaces, the accessible name.
Dismissible with Escape without moving focus (WCAG 1.4.13); content must stay short.
Rendered in the portal of the originating ThemeProvider.
responsive: Limited maximum width; text wraps automatically.
customization: className on Tooltip; TooltipContent for custom compositions with TooltipTrigger.
commonMistakes: Using a <span> as the trigger: it is not focusable.
Putting links or buttons inside the tooltip.

examples.name: Controlled
examples.title: Controlled state and immediate opening
examples.description: isOpen + onOpenChange with delay={0}; the content changes after the button action.

examples.name: Variants
examples.title: Long text, no arrow, and disabled
examples.description: Shortcut in the text, long wrapping content, showArrow={false}, and isDisabled controlled by a Switch. The information is also available as visible text.

limits: Not available on touch (intentional behavior of the pattern).
